---
title: "jdtflstyle"
---

## Description

Style template macro for study PDF/RTF outputs.

Opens ODS PDF/RTF destination and creates PDF/RTF file. Also creates global macro variables with timestamps. See article https://support.sas.com/resources/papers/proceedings/proceedings/forum2007/225-2007.pdf for more details on ODS style, markup and tagsets.

## Parameters

**`filename`**

: Name of the output file

  *Required:* Yes

**`filepath`**

: File save path

  *Required:* No

**`type`**

: File extension: RTF/PDF

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `RTF`

**`lmarg`**

: Left margin size

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `1in`

**`rmarg`**

: Right margin size

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `1in`

**`tmarg`**

: Top margin size

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `1in`

**`bmarg`**

: Bottom margin size

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `1in`

**`escapechar`**

: Escape character

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `$`

## Examples

```sas
%jdtflstyle(T_10_1_1);
%jdtflstyle(F_15_1_2,bmarg=0.8in);
```
